clauses.reason: The lead expands the scope of the national emergency declared in Executive Order 14024 (relied on in Executive Order 14039), finding that Russia's war against Ukraine, including its recent further invasion, further threatens the peace, stability, sovereignty and territorial integrity of Ukraine. No held instrument revokes, supersedes, amends or limits this clause. The national emergency it expands (declared in Executive Order 14024) was continued by the Federal Register notices of April 13, 2022, April 7, 2023, April 9, 2024, April 10, 2025 and March 24, 2026; the last, dated March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515), continues it beyond April 15, 2026 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14, and each of those notices records that Executive Order 14066 expanded the emergency. Executive Order 14329 of August 6, 2025 and Executive Order 14384 of February 6, 2026 recite Executive Order 14066 and its import prohibition and state that the emergency continues and that the other measures taken to address it are maintained; neither revokes or modifies this order. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14.
